profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: Skilled in Communication, Administration, Design, and Web development. Graduated from Operation Spark as a full-stack developer.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
Develops and maintains responsive, accessible interfaces for the School of Architecture using Drupal and WordPress, adhering to strict WCAG 2.1 standards.
Manages outsourced development teams, providing technical oversight, code reviews, and ensuring alignment with university architecture.
Led the UX/UI design and full-stack development of a faculty/staff intranet; managed project lifecycle from conception through deployment using Agile methodologies.
Developed modular UI components and custom Gutenberg blocks to improve content management efficiency for non-technical staff.
Containerized development environments with Docker and managed version control via Pantheon to streamline team collaboration.
positions.insights: Skills: Git · Front-end Coding · Internet Software · Visual Web Developer · Web Design · Software Development · Analytics · Project Management

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
Operation Spark is a software engineering boot camp focusing on web and app development.
Served as the first contact with students who need technical assistance.
Troubleshoot, diagnose, and resolve technical software issues.
Assists students with programming assignments
positions.insights: Skills: Git · SQL · Front-end Coding · Pair Programming

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed front-end layouts using Javascript, Ionic, Angular, and CSS/SASS methods.
Created a component to display a list of festival vendors' menus on click. Data from APT query and ionic style components were used. Performed app updates.
I refactored the existing code and added dynamic functionality to various features, such as the festival vendors page and user favorites page, using data from local storage.

positions.title: Office Administrator
positions.description:
Performed a wide variety of tasks in daily work. This usually includes standard clerical duties such as answering incoming inquiries, managing appointment calendars, troubleshooting machines,
process and review insurance documentation and ensure all documents are complete, maintain office supply inventory, serve as a back-up for other jobs as necessary, gain in-depth and thorough understanding P&C, file, and maintain customer insurance files.

positions.title: Administrative Assistant
positions.description: Assigned with the task of preparing legal documents and letters of communication; Answer multi-line phone system; Prepare bookings for new client files/grievances for attorney consultations.  Communicate regularly with new and current clientele.  Maintain a filing system according to each category of legal proceedings.  Process all incoming and outgoing documentation to include mail, packages, supplies, processed payments etc. Managed attorney appointment and court schedule.  Assist attorney with any and all other duties as deemed necessary.
